property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array, transfer returns true and either all external transferFrom calls succeed (no revert) or the call reverts; if it returns true then none of the internal calls reverted.
If C.transfer returns true then it must not revert (i.e. the call succeeded) and the input _tos array was non-empty (precondition), so return true implies no revert and _tos.length>0.
If transfer returns true then every internal call to caddress.transferFrom for each _tos element must have succeeded (i.e., transfer returning true implies no revert occurred during the loop).
